title: Ave stella matutina (Maistre Jan)
desc: Maistre Jan, Ave stella matutina. 4 voices (Superius, Altus I, Altus II, Bassus), each on its own staff. No text in this edition. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
